newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed Thursday, with a German denial of central bank gold sales and a stronger yen both helping the yellow metal to move higher, the latter also boosting platinum, floor sources said.
COMEX June gold was called up $0.50 to $1.00 from Wednesday's close of $348.20 an ounce after trading from $349.80 to $348.40 on ACCESS.
COMEX July silver was called up 1.00 to 2.00 cents after trading between $4.865 and $4.84 on ACCESS.

A newspaper reported that the Bundesbank may revalue its huge gold assets, but the German finance ministry later denied it would sell any gold, though official sources said there would be discussions about increasing the book value of the gold held to boost the bank's profit.
London gold fixed a touch lower Thursday morning at $347.10 an ounce, down $1.00 from Wednesday afternoon.
COMEX gold stocks on Wednesday fell 5,020 ounces to 896,475 ounces, while the exchange's silver stocks were up 465,808 ounces at 191,063,032 ounces.
NYMEX July platinum was called up $0.50 to $1.00 from Wednesday's close of $393.80, with NYMEX June palladium called $1.00 weaker from $173.90 at yesterday's finish.
